tpl: Fires scorching bullets that leave incendiary marks at fixed distances as they travel. The bullets explode upon reaching maximum attack range, dealing {0} Physical Damage and causing incendiary marks to explode in sequence, dealing {1} Physical Damage

Continuously barrages a fixed area in front of this unit at max range, expanding explosion area and increasing ATK to {0}. Enemies closer to the impact site in a smaller area will instead take {1} ATK as damage. Unlimited duration, can manually deactivate skill
